title: Deleted image retention decision
purpose: Document the unresolved conflict over what happens to an uploaded image after its owner selects Delete, and capture the mechanics that remain undecided.

scope.text: Two competing requests exist for the behavior after an owner selects Delete on an uploaded image: immediate permanent deletion, or retention with 30-day owner recovery. No stakeholder has authority to choose between these requests yet.

requirements.text: Privacy stakeholder requests immediate permanent deletion of an uploaded image when its owner selects Delete.
Support stakeholder requests that the same deleted image remain recoverable by its owner for 30 days after Delete.

stories.text: If a human selects the immediate-deletion policy, an image owner can delete an uploaded image so that it is permanently deleted immediately.
acceptance_criteria: Given a human has selected the immediate-deletion policy, when an owner selects Delete on an uploaded image, then the image is permanently deleted immediately.
Given a human has selected the immediate-deletion policy, when an owner selects Delete on an uploaded image, then the image is not recoverable by its owner afterward.

stories.text: If a human selects the 30-day recovery policy, an image owner can delete an uploaded image while retaining the ability to recover it for 30 days after Delete.
acceptance_criteria: Given a human has selected the 30-day recovery policy, when an owner selects Delete on an uploaded image, then the image remains recoverable by its owner for 30 days after Delete.
Given a human has selected the 30-day recovery policy, when the owner requests recovery of the image 30 days after Delete, then the image is returned to the owner.

dependencies.text: Which policy applies to an image after its owner selects Delete is unresolved, and no stakeholder has authority to choose between these requests yet.

risks.text: Immediate permanent deletion would fail the support request that the image remain recoverable by its owner for 30 days; 30-day owner recovery would fail the privacy request for immediate permanent deletion.

open_questions: Which policy should a human select: immediate permanent deletion or 30-day owner recovery after Delete?
Who has authority to select the policy between these requests?
Is the 30-day recovery period measured from the moment Delete is selected, and what is the exact time basis (for example, calendar days or 24-hour periods)?
Is the endpoint of the 30-day recovery period inclusive or exclusive?
What behavior is required for the image after the 30-day recovery period ends (for example, permanent deletion), given that neither request specifies it?

Does the immediate-deletion request's obligation still apply if the 30-day recovery request is selected, and does the 30-day recovery obligation still apply if the immediate-deletion request is selected?
